name: Amanata Pressure
description: When Combo Multiplier reaches 8x, Heavy attacks apply a random Status Effect to enemies hit.
descriptionEn: When Combo Multiplier reaches 8x, Heavy attacks apply a random Status Effect to enemies hit.
descriptionZh: 当连击倍率达到 8 倍时，重击会对被击中的敌人造成随机异常状态。

name: Coiling Viper
description: Powerful arcing strikes with energetic flips.
descriptionEn: Powerful arcing strikes with energetic flips.
descriptionZh: 带着强力翻转的弧状攻击。

name: Burning Wasp
descriptionZh: 施展连环鞭击。

name: Votive Onslaught
description: Precise, focused arcs and cuts not hampered by pity.
descriptionEn: Precise, focused arcs and cuts not hampered by pity.
descriptionZh: 精确、集中的弧切，不带一丝怜悯。

name: Slicing Feathers
description: Twirling, acrobatic slashes with a refined touch.
descriptionEn: Twirling, acrobatic slashes with a refined touch.
descriptionZh: 旋转、杂技般的挥砍，配合着精妙的点睛招式。

name: Sovereign Outcast
description: An outlandish style with sweeping attacks.
descriptionEn: An outlandish style with sweeping attacks.
descriptionZh: 有着连绵不绝攻击手段的诡异风格。

name: Gemini Cross
description: A style exhibiting sweeping slash attacks and swift jabs.
descriptionEn: A style exhibiting sweeping slash attacks and swift jabs.
descriptionZh: 一种扫荡般的切斩以及戳刺攻击方式。

name: Defiled Snapdragon
descriptionZh: 迅如闪电的鞭笞，致命般的砍击。

name: Eleventh Storm
description: Rapid attacks using sword and shield.
descriptionEn: Rapid attacks using sword and shield.
descriptionZh: 使用剑和盾的快速攻击。

name: Swooping Falcon
descriptionZh: 旋转突刺中的快速斩击。

name: Vengeful Revenant
descriptionZh: 憎恨……恐惧……绝望……

name: Flailing Branch
descriptionZh: 上升打击和旋风的连段。

name: Stalking Fan
descriptionZh: 毁灭性的冲刺螺旋连段。

name: Reaping Spiral
description: Far flung attacks and multi-hit combos.
descriptionEn: Far flung attacks and multi-hit combos.
descriptionZh: 大范围的挥动攻击与多次命中的连段。

name: Butcher's Revelry
description: Rip and rend with this Assault Saw stance.
descriptionEn: Rip and rend with this Assault Saw stance.
descriptionZh: 采用这种突击锯架势来撕裂并锯碎你的敌人。

name: Final Harbinger
descriptionZh: 强力的斩切与盾牌攻击。

name: Vulpine Mask
descriptionZh: 快速切割，刺穿攻击

name: Brutal Tide
descriptionZh: 回旋踢和飞越拳击。

name: Grim Fury
description: Lightning fast hit chains and hard-hitting combos.
descriptionEn: Lightning fast hit chains and hard-hitting combos.
descriptionZh: 闪电般迅速的连击和重击组合。

name: Bleeding Willow
description: A blend of strong and rapid strikes with leaping combos.
descriptionEn: A blend of strong and rapid strikes with leaping combos.
descriptionZh: 强大的和快速攻击与跳跃组合。

name: Twirling Spire
description: A mix of sweeping attacks with precise strikes.
descriptionEn: A mix of sweeping attacks with precise strikes.
descriptionZh: 大范围的扫打与精准打击的混合。

name: Shimmering Blight
description: Fast spinning attacks and staggering strikes.
descriptionEn: Fast spinning attacks and staggering strikes.
descriptionZh: 快速旋转攻击和惊人的突击。

name: Atlantis Vulcan
descriptionZh: 虚实难辨、动作快速的打击。

name: Cyclone Kraken
descriptionZh: 带有灵巧移动的残暴攻击。

name: Sundering Weave
description: Steady chopping strikes with focused damage.
descriptionEn: Steady chopping strikes with focused damage.
descriptionZh: 造成集中伤害的沉稳切击。

name: Wise Razor
descriptionZh: 灵巧般完成扫荡和斩击

name: Decisive Judgement
descriptionZh: 凶猛的双持打击。

name: Blind Justice
description: Reverse grip style emphasizing slashing and impaling strikes.
descriptionEn: Reverse grip style emphasizing slashing and impaling strikes.
descriptionZh: 反握的持刀风格，强调其猛烈的斩击以及刺击。

name: Tranquil Cleave
descriptionZh: 强力弧斩附带疯狂的连段。

name: Iron Phoenix
description: Fast cutting attacks with puncture finish.
descriptionEn: Fast cutting attacks with puncture finish.
descriptionZh: 快速切割攻击用穿刺完结。

name: Galeforce Dawn
descriptionZh: 横扫切割与重型打击。

name: Crushing Ruin
description: Aerial attacks with Crowd Control combos.
descriptionEn: Aerial attacks with Crowd Control combos.
descriptionZh: 空中攻击具备群体控制的攻击连段。

name: Shattering Storm
description: Methodical strikes and high impact combos.
descriptionEn: Methodical strikes and high impact combos.
descriptionZh: 流畅打击和高冲击的连段。

name: Bullet Dance
descriptionZh: 枪火与刀锋交织的华丽漫舞。

name: High Noon
description: Bullets spray between wicked slash attacks.
descriptionEn: Bullets spray between wicked slash attacks.
descriptionZh: 在连续的凶狠斩击之间开火射击

name: Astral Twilight
descriptionZh: 周身环绕的切斩与甩击。

name: Gleaming Talon
descriptionZh: 快速的飞弧攻击。

name: Seismic Palm
descriptionZh: 有条不紊的近距离组合攻击。

name: Gaia's Tragedy
descriptionZh: 缓慢而沉重的打击

name: Fracturing Wind
description: Fast, multi-hit strikes with powerful finishers.
descriptionEn: Fast, multi-hit strikes with powerful finishers.
descriptionZh: 快速，多次命中的打击与强力的处决攻击。

name: Crossing Snakes
description: Multi-angle strikes and deadly thrust attacks.
descriptionEn: Multi-angle strikes and deadly thrust attacks.
descriptionZh: 多重角度攻击和致命刺击。

name: Carving Mantis
description: Strong slashes and quick stabs that keeps momentum forward.
descriptionEn: Strong slashes and quick stabs that keeps momentum forward.
descriptionZh: 强力的斩击和快速的戳刺，保持向前的动量。

name: Swirling Tiger
descriptionZh: 扇动，多段命中的攻击。

name: Mountain's Edge
descriptionZh: 动作迅猛、打击面广。

name: Gnashing Payara
descriptionZh: 以贯通螺旋刺穿。

name: Spinning Needle
descriptionZh: 迅速刺击，扭转切割

name: Sinking Talon
description: Strong, focused attacks with multi-hit spins.
descriptionEn: Strong, focused attacks with multi-hit spins.
descriptionZh: 强劲，多段命中的旋转集中攻击。

name: Pointed Wind
descriptionZh: 旋转打击，不断上升的连段。

name: Stinging Thorn
descriptionZh: 带有强力刺击的凶猛挥砍

name: Homing Fang
descriptionZh: 命中多次的快速打击。

name: Crimson Dervish
descriptionZh: 有如旋风般的强烈攻击。

name: Vermillion Storm
descriptionZh: 在旋转的切斩之中组合了踢击。

name: Four Riders
descriptionZh: 快速的打击与强烈猛击。

name: Malicious Raptor
descriptionZh: 穿刺攻击和快速的切割。

name: Harrowing Spire
description: Relentless jabs and powerful sweeping lunges.
descriptionEn: Relentless jabs and powerful sweeping lunges.
descriptionZh: 持续不断的戳刺和强劲有力的横扫式冲刺。

name: Cleaving Whirlwind
descriptionZh: 弧切与回旋斩。

name: Tempo Royale
descriptionZh: 扫荡般的挥击与曲斜的斩击。

name: Rending Crane
description: Downward cuts with an impact combo.
descriptionEn: Downward cuts with an impact combo.
descriptionZh: 下砍附带冲击的连段。

name: Higasa Serration
description: Alternate Fire applies a random Status Effect to enemies hit.
descriptionEn: Alternate Fire applies a random Status Effect to enemies hit.
descriptionZh: 次要射击会对被击中的敌人造成一种随机异常状态。

The sky and Earth aflame

Its heralds are the stars it fells

天地燃烧

Corporeal laws are unwrit

As suns and love retreat
descriptionZh:
定律归零

太阳和爱退缩

In madness lost shall die
descriptionEn:
Roiling, moaning, this realm of ours

In madness lost shall die

Carrion hordes trill their profane

Accord with eldritch plans

description:
To cosmic madness laws submit

Though stalwart minds entreat

description:
In luminous space blackened stars

They gaze, accuse, deny
descriptionEn:
In luminous space blackened stars

They gaze, accuse, deny

光明的太空之中，飘荡着焦黑的星辰

它们凝视、指责、否认

description:
To cosmic forms from tangent planes

We end as we began

To cosmic forms from tangent planes

We end as we began
descriptionZh:
对于从相切位面演化出的宇宙来说

我们的结局又回到了开始
